name: 連絡先表示名と並び替え・更新条件の概要帯
prompt:
Reframe the first supplied image (registered v001) into the exact 620x128 wide shallow strip represented by the second image (the original Salesforce crop). Preserve the content and Japanese wording, but correct the canvas and element scale. Final aspect ratio must be 4.84:1 with no blank bands above or below.

The visible content in v001 is centered in a 3:1 canvas with large empty margins. Remove those margins by cropping/reframing around the actual header strip; do not shrink the row into a tall page. Match the source's shallow 128-pixel height relative to its width: small purple circular Contacts icon at left, small gray 「連絡先」 label above the dark-navy heading 「最近表示した連絡先」 with its small down-caret, and the small outlined circular blue pin control to the right. Keep the muted metadata line 「4件 • 名前順 • 最近表示で絞り込み • 数秒前に更新」 near the lower edge on one line.

Use the first image only to retain Japanese content. Use the second image as the authority for scale, spacing, icon size, and crop. Do not enlarge the title, icon, or metadata. Do not add right-side action buttons, card borders, blank margins, or any other content. The final frame should be filled by this compact shallow header and its metadata, matching the second image's 620:128 proportions.
reviewNotes: The bounded second reframe still returns a 2171x724 (3:1) canvas versus the 620x128 (4.84:1) source crop. Japanese heading and metadata remain oversized; all source content and state are present, but geometry is materially off. Two attempts used; retain as needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
